title: He Turned $27 Million Into $2.6 Billion in One Month #shorts
description:
In early 2020, hedge fund manager Bill Ackman bet that the world was underpricing a pandemic. A tiny insurance-style bet became a $2.6 billion profit in about a month.
Follow for more true stories of fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Genius timing or pure luck? Would you have made this bet in February 2020? 👇

lines.text: In February twenty twenty, a hedge fund manager spent twenty-seven million dollars on a strange bet.
One month later, it was worth two point six billion.
While markets were at record highs, he saw something others ignored.
A virus was spreading across the world.
So he bought insurance against a crash in corporate debt. It cost almost nothing.
If he was wrong, he'd lose a tiny sliver of his fund.
If he was right, the payoff would be enormous.
In March, he went on television and warned: hell is coming.
Days later, the market collapsed. Lockdowns shut the world.
He sold his bet for a profit of two point six billion dollars.
Then he used the cash to buy stocks at the bottom.
Follow for more true stories of fortunes made and lost.
